skills.name: 断粮
skills.text: 出牌阶段限一次，你可以与一名其他角色进行“谋弈”：围城断粮：你将一张牌堆顶的牌当做【兵粮寸断】对其使用且无距离限制。若其判定区已有【兵粮寸断】，则改为获得其一张牌。擂鼓进军：你视为对其使用一张【决斗】。

skills.name: 势迫
skills.text: 结束阶段，你可以令一名体力值少于你的角色或所有判定区有【兵粮寸断】的其他角色选择一项：1. 交给你一张手牌；2. 受到1点伤害。若你以此法获得了牌，则你可以将其中任意张牌交给一名其他角色。

engineeringInterpretations: The current official hero and the formal 2022-08-24 revision agree on the complete current two-skill version. The older discard-or-owner-draw Shipo is not mixed into it.

Duanliang is not pindian and does not require a Hand card. Private strategy commitments stay on the owning frame; public committed facts contain no strategy bit until the common reveal. Viewer snapshots and AI public valuations cannot inspect the other commitment or hidden deck top.

On successful siege, an existing effective SupplyShortage in Judgment changes the consequence to exact native HEJ obtain. It does not consume top. Otherwise one real physical top entity is used as SupplyShortage, preserving its suit/rank/printed provenance, with distance exemption only and normal native prohibitions, nullification, delayed placement and later judgment.

Successful advance is a genuine zero-material Duel Use, not a bare program-owned Slash-exchange helper. It preserves native declaration, acceptance, targets, nullification, responses, damage, recovery, dying and exactly-once whole-use completion.

Shipo recipients give only actual Hand entities or suffer genuine normal damage1 from the original owner. Armor, prevention, damage conversion, HP changes, rescue and death use native processing. Equipment or another private zone cannot pay the Hand clause.

Optional redistribution permits any nonempty subset of the exact entities actually obtained through this Shipo and still in the owner Hand, to exactly one living other. Initial Hand, unrelated child draws, departed entities and normalized OutsideGame cards are excluded. Use private incremental selection rather than enumerating all subsets, and one native atomic FaceDown transfer.

All pending state belongs to its exact native ProgramSkillFrame/typed child return. Collection-bearing facts must be frozen before commit. No global rules epoch, RulesVersion, schema bump or per-general package bump is introduced.

The signed native origin freezes effective color together with suit, rank, printed kind and original DrawPile material location. A genuine empty-material Duel signs its neutral appearance. Current policies cannot silently replace a signed accepted appearance.

After successful Advance only, existing next-use target grants may offer their native legal optional target plans. No grant adds no extra confirmation. The immutable selected plan stays on the owning receipt and is signed by scalar target facts. Later native target additions and repeated effects finish the whole genuine Duel before its exact typed parent return.
verificationLimits: Official hero/API and formal revised skill text were checked, preserving both complete skills. The exact official portrait was hashed, dimension-checked and visually inspected. No authenticated mobile client or character-specific official FAQ was used.

Focused behavior, relevant shared mechanisms, actual WPF gallery rendering and bounded routine checks passed. No manual Full run or complete foreground match. Engineering interpretations are explicitly separate from official wording and user-selected rulings.
